title: Bing Ruo Meimei Zong Shi Xiao Xiang Wo
titleRomaji: Bing Ruo Meimei Zong Shi Xiao Xiang Wo
titleNative: 病弱妹妹总是肖想我
synonyms: My Sickly Sister Always Misses Me
synopsis: Xu Yulian is the eldest daughter of a wealthy family, smart and beautiful. Her life should've been a smooth ride, until she ran into a stumbling block named "Xu Wenjiao." Her sister came out of nowhere and became the person she hates the most. When she was a child, the frail Xu Wenjiao occupied all of her mother's time and attention. After she grew up, Xu Yulian had a crush on the neighbor girl who had just returned from studying abroad. But before she could get up the courage, she saw the girl confess to Xu Wenjiao instead. In this house, it's going to be either her or Xu Wenjiao, one or the other. Xu Yulian got so angry that she actually packed her bags to leave home, but her sister, who always seemed so weak and frail, suddenly grabbed her by the wrist wrist and pushed her into the corner. Xu Wenjiao looked at her jealously and whispered in her ear: "Sister, why do you like her but not me?" Xu Yulian blushed, "Xu Wenjiao, are you crazy? Have you been reading too many bad romance novels to be acting this way?" (Source: Bilibili, translated)

synopsis: There was a mage called "The Lone Demon King" at the frontier. He was just a creature that never grew old, but he was loved by the villagers as something of a guardian deity. However, he was destroyed by a magic organization that sees his existence as dangerous. 200 years later, he is reincarnated as the second son of an aristocrat and obtains the strongest magic power. "Let's pretend to be a human this time..." However, being a human lover, he didn't particularly think of revenge and has decided to pretend to be human in this life. In his past life, he was the guardian deity of a region, and in this life, he's a local aristocrat, but he does not know common sense. He doesn't know how to take it easy. As the second son of an aristocrat, he is loved by his family and friends, and while he is regarded as a master of magic in the magic guild, he becomes an "Immortal Mage" behind the scenes. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

The Hiroi household is home to Shouya, a guy eight years older than her. Umi admires him, and her heart races at their long-awaited reunion. But the Shouya she encounters is completely different from the one in her memories... A faintly sparkling cohabitation story about meeting changed memories once more. titleNative: 行き着く先は勇者か魔王か
synonyms: Is the destination a hero or a demon king?
synopsis: "I found it." With these words, Yuuto Mamiya, an office worker, is dragged into a mysterious space, where a boy with an acorn head offers him a transfer to another world. However, it turns out that the boy intends to transfer him to another world without obtaining any abilities, and Yuuto negotiates with him because he will die if he does so. But, all he gets is a rejuvenated body and the ability to view his "status screen" at any time! Yuuto is thrown out into the sea of trees in another world without becoming strong at all. He takes the first step to survive with the game knowledge and perseverance that he has gained to the point of earning the title of "Abandoned God". His goal is to find a human village. (Source: Overlap, translated)
